title: Integrate Chronicling America obituaries (OCR, PD titles)
context: Chronicling America (Library of Congress / NEH) hosts public-domain historic newspaper issues with OCR text, making obituaries and death notices a potential source of birth, death, and relationship facts for the corpus. However, not all titles in Chronicling America are public domain — rights vary per title and per date range — so each title used must be individually verified as PD before extraction. OCR quality also varies and must be evaluated per title; the extraction method (OCR) must be recorded in provenance. This is a backlog task for post-M3.
objective: Identify at least one Chronicling America newspaper title whose selected issues are confirmed public domain, verify the per-title rights, add it to sources/allowlist.yml with both reviewer sign-offs, and extract a batch of obituary-derived Person/Fact records into the corpus with OCR noted as the extraction method in provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one Chronicling America title and date range confirmed public domain (per-title rights analysis, not assumed from the aggregator); entry added to sources/allowlist.yml with both license and privacy reviewer sign-offs.
OCR extraction method recorded in the provenance block of every assertion produced from this source.
Transcription-accuracy baseline applied for OCR: ambiguous or low-confidence OCR fields flagged for review, never silently accepted.
Deceased-determination applied: persons admitted only if classified deceased under the ratified policy.
100% of new assertions carry provenance (Chronicling America page/image URL) and evidence rationale.
All CI gates pass before PR submission.
Batch committed to corpus/ via PR with per-title rights analysis in the allow-list entry.
output: corpus/chronicling-america-<title>-<date-range>/ — extracted batch of obituary records, committed via PR.
